name: Sourcing Copilot
tagline: Drafts RFx packs, sourcing strategies and supplier shortlists from category data.
about: Sourcing Copilot sits on top of the procurement platform and turns a category brief into a first-draft RFx pack: scope, evaluation criteria and a supplier shortlist pulled from our vendor master. It has been in production since January and is fully supported by Emplay under the platform SLA.
how: Reads your category brief and recent sourcing history from the platform
Drafts the RFx structure, evaluation criteria and timelines
You review, edit and publish — nothing is sent without your sign-off
sample_prompts: Draft an RFQ for network maintenance services in Germany
Shortlist suppliers for SD-WAN hardware under existing frameworks
canned_reply: Here is a first-draft RFQ structure: scope of works, 6 evaluation criteria weighted for TCO, and a 4-week timeline. I found 7 qualified suppliers on active frameworks — want me to add them to the invite list?

reviews.text: Cut my RFx drafting from two days to two hours.
Shortlists are spot on. Timeline suggestions still need a human eye.

name: Contract IQ
tagline: Extracts clauses, obligations and renewal risks from any contract in the repository.
about: Contract IQ runs on our GCP environment and indexes the full contract repository. Ask it about liability caps, notice periods or auto-renewals across a supplier portfolio. Because contracts contain commercially sensitive terms, access is restricted by role.
audience: the contract management and legal teams
how: Indexes executed contracts from the repository nightly
Answers clause-level questions with citations to the source document
Flags renewal and obligation deadlines to owners 90 days ahead
sample_prompts: Which supplier contracts auto-renew in the next quarter?
Summarise the liability caps across our top 10 IT vendors
canned_reply: 3 contracts auto-renew next quarter. Two have 60-day notice periods expiring within 3 weeks — I can draft the non-renewal notices now.

reviews.text: Found a 60-day notice window we would have missed. Paid for itself.
Clause citations are accurate; bulk export could be smoother.

name: Spend Lens
tagline: Answers spend questions in plain language over the Looker spend models.
about: Spend Lens is a conversational layer over our certified Looker spend models. It answers plain-language questions with charts and always shows the underlying query, so numbers are traceable to the certified model — no more spreadsheet forks.
how: Translates your question into a query on certified Looker models
Returns the chart plus the exact filters used, for traceability
Lets you pin answers to a personal board or share to Teams
sample_prompts: Show tail spend by market for the last two quarters
Which categories are trending over budget this year?
canned_reply: Tail spend was €14.2M last two quarters, concentrated in 3 markets. Germany is up 18% QoQ — here is the breakdown by category with the model filters I used.

reviews.text: Finally one source of truth for spend questions.
Traceable queries make month-end reviews painless.

name: PO Chaser
tagline: Chases overdue POs and drafts polite supplier nudges straight into Outlook.
about: PO Chaser watches your open POs and, when goods receipt or confirmation is overdue, drafts a chase email in your tone with the PO details attached. Built by Anita in Copilot Studio during the Q2 hack week — it is this month’s scale-up winner and is being promoted to production.
how: Checks your open POs against confirmation and GR deadlines daily
Drafts a chase email per overdue PO, matched to your writing tone
You send with one click — replies are threaded back to the PO
sample_prompts: Which of my POs are overdue for confirmation?
Draft chasers for everything overdue more than 5 days
canned_reply: You have 6 POs overdue. I drafted 6 chasers — 4 friendly first nudges and 2 firmer follow-ups for the 10+ day ones. Review and send?

reviews.text: My overdue PO list went from 20 to 3 in two weeks.
The tone-matched drafts are scarily good.

name: Negotiation Prep
tagline: Builds a negotiation brief: supplier financials, our leverage, walk-away points.
about: Negotiation Prep assembles a one-page brief before a supplier meeting: their financial position, our spend and share of wallet, open disputes, and suggested anchors. It touches commercially sensitive strategy, so access is limited to the sourcing community.
how: Pulls supplier financials, our spend history and contract terms
Estimates leverage and suggests anchor and walk-away points
Exports a one-page brief to take into the meeting
sample_prompts: Prep me for the annual renewal with our top logistics supplier
What is our leverage position with vendor X?
canned_reply: Brief ready: our spend is 11% of their revenue (high leverage), 2 open SLA disputes strengthen our position, suggested anchor is a 9% reduction with a 5% walk-away.

reviews.text: Walked into a renewal with leverage I did not know we had.

name: Onboarding Buddy
tagline: Walks new suppliers through onboarding and answers their status questions.
about: Onboarding Buddy answers the two questions that flood the shared mailbox: “what do you need from me?” and “where is my onboarding?”. It tracks each supplier’s step, explains what document is missing and why, and escalates only genuine blockers to the team.
how: Tracks each supplier’s onboarding step in real time
Explains missing documents and requirements in supplier-friendly language
Escalates blockers older than 5 days to the governance team
sample_prompts: Where is supplier Acme in onboarding?
What is blocking the 3 suppliers added last week?
canned_reply: Acme is at step 4 of 6 — waiting on their insurance certificate (requested twice). The other 3 are unblocked and should clear this week.

reviews.text: Suppliers stopped emailing the shared inbox. Bliss.

name: Savings Tracker
tagline: Logs savings initiatives from your notes and keeps the tracker up to date.
about: Savings Tracker turns meeting notes and emails into structured savings entries — initiative, category, run-rate vs one-off, validation status — and syncs them to the central tracker so month-end reporting stops being a scavenger hunt.
how: Parses notes or emails you forward to it for savings signals
Structures them into the standard savings taxonomy
Syncs to the central tracker and flags entries needing validation
sample_prompts: Log the 7% renewal saving from today’s vendor call
What is still unvalidated for this quarter?
canned_reply: Logged: 7% run-rate saving on the renewal, ~€96k annualised, pending finance validation. You have 4 other unvalidated entries this quarter.

name: Minute Maker
tagline: Turns governance calls into minutes, decisions and tracked actions.
about: Minute Maker joins governance calls, produces minutes in our standard format, extracts decisions and actions with owners and dates, and chases the actions weekly until closed.
how: Joins the call and drafts minutes in the standard template
Extracts decisions and actions with owners and due dates
Chases open actions weekly and reports status to the chair
sample_prompts: Summarise decisions from today’s supplier review board
Which actions from last month are still open?
canned_reply: 3 decisions, 5 actions captured. 2 actions from last month are overdue — I’ve queued reminders to the owners for Monday.

name: Tail-Spend Triage
tagline: Auto-routes small purchase requests to catalogues, cards or quick quotes.
about: An idea to automatically triage sub-€10k requests: route to an existing catalogue item, a purchasing card, or a lightweight 3-quote process — cutting cycle time for the long tail.
how: Classifies incoming low-value requests
Routes to catalogue, card or quick-quote path
Reports leakage and cycle-time savings

name: ESG Compliance Scout
tagline: Monitors supplier ESG disclosures and flags compliance gaps early.
about: An idea to scan supplier ESG disclosures and news signals against our supplier code of conduct, flagging gaps before annual reviews.
how: Monitors disclosures and public ESG signals
Scores gaps against our code of conduct
Alerts supplier managers before reviews

name: Invoice Dispute Resolver
tagline: Matches disputed invoices to POs and GRs and drafts the resolution.
about: An idea to auto-investigate invoice disputes: match invoice, PO and goods receipt, identify the mismatch, and draft the resolution note for the supplier.
how: Three-way matches disputed invoices automatically
Identifies the root-cause mismatch
Drafts the supplier resolution note
